entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Alex. How may I assist you today?

Yeah, hi. I'm calling about this VeloBand Pulse I bought last week. The heart rate monitor is completely busted. It's giving me readings that are physically impossible. I need this for my training and it's completely useless. What are you going to do about it?

I understand your frustration. I'm sorry to hear you're having issues with your VeloBand Pulse. To look into this for you, could I please get your order number or the email address associated with your purchase?

It's [customer's email address]. Look, I don't have time for this. I need a working heart rate monitor. Is it still under warranty or what? I need to know if I can get a new one. I need a replacement ASAP.

Thank you. I've located your order. Let me check the warranty period for the VeloBand Pulse. Oh, wait actually, let me correct myself. I almost misspoke there. Regarding returns for the Pulse... I initially thought the return window was 90 days, but I misspoke. For the Pulse it's actually 10 days. And I apologize for the confusion. I do see that you're calling just within that timeframe.

So, what are you saying? I can return it? Because if I'm stuck with this thing, I'm going to be really upset. I specifically bought this for a race coming up, and I am losing training days because of this.
Yes, you can definitely return it for a full refund or a replacement. Since you're within the 10 days return window, we'd be happy to offer either option. Which would you prefer?
A replacement, definitely. I need one that actually works this time though.

Understood. We can certainly ship out a replacement VeloBand Pulse right away. I'll generate a prepaid shipping label for you to return the defective one. We'll send the replacement as soon as we receive the original one back from you. Does that sound good?
Okay, that sounds perfect. Thank you for clarifying the return policy and getting this sorted out so quickly.

You're very welcome! We appreciate your business. I've emailed you the shipping label and instructions. Please let us know if you have any further questions. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Have a great day with VeloFit!
